authorityBoundary: Agent prompts, project metadata, labels and diagnostics are never transaction permissions.
The agent must not authorize its own onchain publication; stop and request human approval.
Only the M2 importer produces executable circuit input.
goal: Bounded structured agent loop over existing Flip operations; no autonomous write path.

iterationContract.logs: append-only JSONL with step, op, inputHash, outputHash, status, budgetRemaining
iterationContract.reproducibleOutputs: request hash, tool hashes, resource metrics and verdict recorded
iterationContract.success: verified EQUIVALENT or completed evidence export with no CURRENT claim

retryRules: Only UNKNOWN may be retried; DIFFERENT and STALE require a declared change.
At most maxRetries attempts; each attempt gets a fresh deadline and freshness check.
Never retry a validation failure by weakening limits or accepting self-declared flags.
